targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", strategy, MAX(rows_inserted) AS rows FROM bench_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts, strategy ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS "time", strategy, MAX(throughput_rps) AS rps FROM bench_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts, strategy ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS "time", strategy, MAX(cpu_pct) AS cpu FROM bench_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts, strategy ORDER BY ts

SELECT loader, rows_loaded, round(duration_sec::numeric, 2) AS "Duration (s)", round(rows_per_sec::numeric, 0) AS "Rows/sec", peak_cpu_pct, peak_mem_mb, error_count FROM benchmark_results ORDER BY duration_sec ASC
